I'm migrating over to Protonmail which boasts end to end encryption. Is there a way to tell if I'm actually using it?
How do i know that my email is using end to end encryption?

protonmail only provides end-to-end encryption if you're emailing another protonmail user. you can use "encrypt for 3rd parties", which pulls users to protonmail to read the email. as for "knowing" that you're using end-to-end encryption, you basically have to take it on faith.
Oh Wow. Ok. Good to know. Good info all around. Thanks.

if you want certainty in end-to-end encryption, you should consider using GnuPG or PGP -- the "problem" with that is that you have to perform your own manual key exchange. Depending on how many people you want to guarantee secure communications with, this may or may not be a big deal. So, YMMV.
